Hello M
axime Maucler﻿,﻿
Hope you are doing well.
We analyzed the logs and found that the door was opened, which caused the fuse to trip.
As you can see, the Door was opened. Please confirm this information, otherwise if the door was not open then maybe the sensor is not working properly.
The charger is now showing as healthy on SCB with no active error flags. If there are no further queries, shall we proceed to close the ticket.?
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
